text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after the Satsuki Sho, Agnes Tachyon suddenly holds a press conference, during which she announces she'll be taking an indefinite hiatus from racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon may have lost out at the Satsuki Sho, but she's still the favorite in two upcoming races. Why do this? Refusing to explain herself, she ends the press conference as abruptly as she announced it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having won the Satsuki Sho with her incredible running, Agnes Tachyon was on her way to becoming a triple crown holder. So, why do this? Refusing to explain herself, she ends the press conference as abruptly as she announced it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, Agnes Tachyon asks for permission to become Manhattan Cafe's advisor, of all things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't figure out what Agnes Tachyon is up to. However, with Manhattan Cafe taking up her offer, we end up tackling the road to the Classics as a trio.
